title: US equity markets close early at 1:00 p.m. ET — Christmas Eve, with the bond tape open an hour longer
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes; the page needs curl -L and its holiday data is JSON-ish '"text":"..."' cells rather than HTML table markup), parsed footnote-by-footnote by this session. The Christmas Day row parses as ['Friday, December 25****', 'Friday, December 24 (Christmas Day observed)', 'Monday, December 25'] for 2026 / 2027 / 2028, and footnote **** reads verbatim: 'Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Thursday, December 24, 2026. NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m. All times are Eastern Time.' Note the footnote is attached to 2026 only — NYSE publishes no equity early close ahead of the observed-Friday Christmas in 2027. Filed estimate rather than confirmed because the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for an exchange operator's own hours page and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep.
notes: DISCOVERED during the sifma-bond-early-close-2027-03-25 initial research (2026-09-05), while extracting all four of NYSE's early-close footnotes rather than the single Thanksgiving one a prior lane read. This date has been found and declined once before: thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27's own notes record that the japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2026-12-25 lane found the 2026-12-24 half-day as a dated primary-sourced adjacency and declined to file it because no EventKind slot for a trading-hours event existed yet. That schema question has since been settled in practice — good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 and thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 both carry US trading-hours events as kind 'sector', impact low, symbols [], status estimate with a NEWS: source, and both validate clean. This entry reuses that precedent exactly; no new kind is invented, and it closes an asymmetry where the Thanksgiving equity half-day was tracked and its Christmas Eve twin was not. WHAT MAKES THE SESSION UNUSUAL: it is one of only three dated days in the published 2026-2027 window where the BOND tape outlives the equity tape. NYSE closes equities at 13:00 ET while SIFMA recommends fixed income close at 14:00 ET (sifma.org/resources/guides-playbooks/holiday-schedule, re-fetched and re-parsed 2026-09-05: US 2026 panel, 'Christmas Day | Friday, December 25, 2026 | Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Thursday, December 24, 2026'). That is the inverse of the far more common shape, in which bonds shut two hours BEFORE a full equity session — nine of the twelve dated pairs in that window. IMPACT LOW AND STRUCTURAL ONLY: an early close moves nothing by itself, no house playbook is calendar- or holiday-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped for 'holiday|good friday|closure|half-day|early close' this session: zero hits in both), and symbols is empty. It changes how other events near it are READ, not what anything is worth. HONEST LIMIT: whether CME keeps separate hours that afternoon is NOT asserted — cmegroup.com returned HTTP 403 to this runner on five attempts across three URL forms and two browser user-agents, so the futures leg is unresearched rather than assumed.
